name: Fixedvowelconsonantshift

description_json.name: FixedVowelConsonantShift
description_json.idea: A simple, highly reliable substitution cipher that shifts vowels and consonants independently within their own closed loops. Vowels (A, E, I, O, U) are shifted forward by 1 position (A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A). Consonants are shifted forward by 1 position within the consonant-only alphabet (B->C, C->D, D->F, F->G, G->H, H->J, J->K, K->L, L->M, M->N, N->P, P->Q, Q->R, R->S, S->T, T->V, V->W, W->X, X->Y, Y->Z, Z->B). Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the plaintext:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U), shift it to the next vowel in the sequence: A->E, E->I, I->O, O->U, U->A. Preserve case (e.g., a->e, A->E).
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the next consonant in the consonant-only alphabet: B->C, C->D, D->F, F->G, G->H, H->J, J->K, K->L, L->M, M->N, N->P, P->Q, Q->R, R->S, S->T, T->V, V->W, W->X, X->Y, Y->Z, Z->B. Preserve case (e.g., b->c, B->C).
3. If it is a space, digit, punctuation, or any other non-alphabetic character, leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the ciphertext:
1. If it is a vowel (A, E, I, O, U), shift it to the previous vowel in the sequence: E->A, I->E, O->I, U->O, A->U. Preserve case (e.g., e->a, E->A).
2. If it is a consonant, shift it to the previous consonant in the consonant-only alphabet: C->B, D->C, F->D, G->F, H->G, J->H, K->J, L->K, M->L, N->M, P->N, Q->P, R->Q, S->R, T->S, V->T, W->V, X->W, Y->X, Z->Y, B->Z. Preserve case (e.g., c->b, C->B).
3. If it is a space, digit, punctuation, or any other non-alphabetic character, leave it completely unchanged.
